# Official Apex fixtures

Captured 2026-10-25 from the Russian official Gran Turismo website:
- Menu: https://www.gran-turismo.com/ru/gt7/api/apex/
- Introduction: https://www.gran-turismo.com/ru/gt7/api/apex_v2/?u=/top
- Force: https://www.gran-turismo.com/ru/gt7/api/apex_v2/?u=/engineering_for_automotive/force_energy_vibration/01
- Engine: https://www.gran-turismo.com/ru/gt7/api/apex_v2/?u=/review_mechanism/engine/01

Original text and illustrations: Sony Interactive Entertainment / Polyphony Digital.
Fixtures preserve the upstream JSON, relative image paths, captions, line breaks,
and even the malformed unclosed bold tag in the force article. They are used for
parser regression checks; the running reader retrieves current official content.

English edition fixtures, captured 2026-10-25 for language-switch regression:
